name: Leidos Holdings
supersedes: 2026-07-07 (OWNABLE, 0.5% starter, 1.0% cap, original Aug-4 gate) — AMENDED below after a primary-source segment recast + fable red-team
verdict: NO ADD NOW; ADD ~0.5% (to the 1.0% cap) ONLY behind an AMENDED Aug-4 gate. STAGE-only, no resting pre-print order.
honesty_axis: The marketed FEAR takeaway (Health being cut in half NOW) diverges from the reported data (Health rev flat, OI $284M, funded backlog doubled) — but the court corrected MY framing too: the near-term hold is because FY26 is PRE-FUNDED, and the FY27 reset (VA recompete + DHA integrator unwind) is real and unpriced-either-way. Not a liar-exclusion catch; a dated-reset probability disagreement.

primary_source_findings.segment_recast_Q1_26: 10-Q CIK 1336920 (period ended Apr-3-2026): NEW 4-segment structure eff. FY26 — Intelligence Digital / Health / Homeland / Defense. Q1'26 vs recast Q1'25 seg OI ($M): Intel 146 vs 132 (+10.6%); HEALTH 284 vs 288 (-1.4%, 23.9% margin); Homeland 33 vs 61 (-45.9%, 4.0% margin); Defense 62 vs 74 (-16.2%); total seg 525 vs 555; Corporate -17 vs -25; total OI 508 vs 530. Rev 4,400 vs 4,245 (+3.65%).
primary_source_findings.backlog_by_segment: Apr-3-26 vs Apr-4-25 total ($M): Intel 19,335 vs 17,348 (+11.5%); HEALTH 6,560 vs 8,263 (-20.6%, funded 1,760 vs 832 = +112%, unfunded 4,800 vs 7,431 = -35%); Homeland 9,884 vs 9,974 (incl $371M Entrust); Defense 12,590 vs 10,711 (+17.5%); TOTAL 48,369 vs 46,296 (+4.5%). Health TTM book-to-bill ~0.64x, coverage 1.74x->1.38x.
primary_source_findings.the_pre_funding_tell: USASpending VA->Leidos/QTC family: FY23 $1.11B -> FY24 $1.81B -> FY25 $2.78B -> FY26 $2.23B, with 100% ($2.24B) obligated Oct-Dec-2025 then 7 straight months of zero/negative new obligations. FY26 exam volume is BOUGHT AND PAID FOR (why funded backlog jumped + why the near-term P&L looks fine). FY25 pattern obligated $1.38B in Jul-Sep — whether that repeats for FY27 is the single highest-information free datapoint.
primary_source_findings.the_two_dismantlings: Health has TWO anchors being dismantled: (1) VA C&P exams (the MARGIN) at the ~2027 MDE recompete — a 4th provider = share/price risk; (2) the DHA MHS-Genesis integrator role (the REVENUE) — DHA taking integration in-house on a published schedule: Philips/Amwell out of Leidos mgmt by END-JULY-2026 (before the print), Oracle Nov-2026, Schein/Solventum Jul-2027. The mid-June -12.3% leg was the DHA news (BofA->Neutral 200->125; Jefferies cut).
primary_source_findings.beating_and_raising_CORRECTED: MISLEADING as a thesis pillar — the May-5 FY guide raise was Entrust-mechanical (+$500M rev = Entrust's remaining-year contribution; adj-EPS raise only +$0.05 on $12.30 = +0.4% = organic effectively flat after ~$65M new interest). The beat-and-raise WEEK closed -12.5% on record volume; GAAP EPS fell YoY ($2.56 vs $2.77). Q1'26 press release IS a real +5% adj-EPS/+4% rev print, but the RAISE is not organic.
primary_source_findings.goodwill_CORRECTED: Homeland goodwill is $2,729M (not the $1,791M I first cited — that is DEFENSE's). Homeland carries the company's only impairment scar ($596M accumulated). Entrust ($2.4B cash ~4.3x rev, ~73% booked as goodwill, $1.4B new notes) landed IN Homeland at a 4.0% segment margin; net debt ~$5.88B (~2.4x EBITDA). Buyback authorization nearly exhausted (~512k sh / ~$55M left after buying 1.14M @ $174.94).
primary_source_findings.entrust_amortization_optics_note: ~$25M/qtr Entrust intangible amortization sits INSIDE Homeland segment OI from Q2 onward — Homeland optics will look crushed all year; adjust before reading it as organic decay.
primary_source_findings.shutdown_decoupling: Re-verified on the bars: Sep-29-25->Nov-10-25 close-to-close LDOS -2.1% (all-time high $205.77 printed MID-shutdown) vs BAH -20.3% (caveat: BAH's own guide-down print sits inside that window, so the spread overstates pure shutdown beta).

valuation.at_107_26: 8.7x fwd adj EPS ($12.30 guide mid; consensus $12.27) / ~8.0x EV-EBITDA (EV ~$19.6B / ~$2.46B) / ~11% FCF yield = federal-FLOOR pricing.
valuation.eps_sensitivity: Health OI run-rate ~$1,136M/yr; each -10% Health OI = -$0.71 EPS. Floors at 8.5x: Health -10% -> EPS ~$11.6 -> ~$98; -25% -> ~$10.5 -> ~$89; -50% ('cut in half') -> ~$8.8 -> ~$75.
valuation.mix_headwind: Backlog composition (ID 40.0% / Health 13.6% / Homeland 20.4% / Defense 26.0%) at current segment margins implies a blended segment margin ~9.8% vs 11.9% today = a permanently LOWER base multiple (10.5-11.5x, not the defunct 13-15x); largely priced at 8.7x fwd.

sleeve_rules.free_read: BAH prints its FY27-Q1 ~Jul-28 (1 week before LDOS) — its VBA/civil commentary + book-to-bill are a direct sector read-through to calibrate the gate.
sleeve_rules.macro: Oct-1 cliff MOVED to Dec-4 — House passed CR H.R.9770 (220-205) funding through Dec-4-2026; Senate + signature UNVERIFIABLE as of Jul-23. LDOS's verified decoupling means Dec-4 is far less a reason to defer LDOS than BAH/PSN.

edge_explainer.market_believes: Leidos's most profitable business is being dismantled by its biggest customers on a published calendar — cut it and keep cutting.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The dismantling is real, dated and PARTIAL and the FY26 P&L is holding — but ONLY because FY26 exam volume is already funded; the FY27 reset (VA recompete price/share + DHA integrator unwind) is genuinely two-sided and unresolved. At a federal floor (8.7x / ~11% FCF) the risk is charged at more than its weight, but the edge is a fragile probability vector, not a lay-up.
edge_explainer.why_we_wait: The disagreement resolves NEARLY FREE at Aug-4 (an AMENDED gate that tests the erosion rate, not just the pre-funded print) and again at the Sep-30 USASpending obligation window. Front-running your own gate into a dated DHA headline is negative-EV.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: Aug-4 shows Health backlog erosion accelerating (funded rolling over) OR management can't quantify a bounded DHA exposure OR the Sep-window VA FY27 obligation fails to appear — then the reset is unbounded and the existing starter exits.
edge_explainer.edge_type: over-charged risk, court-tempered to a gated, probability-vector add — small, dated, free-to-resolve.

court_record.dd: SignalOS two-mode, primary-sourced (Q1'26 10-Q + Q1 8-K + XBRL companyfacts + USASpending): the near-term thesis (Health holds) VERIFIED on the P&L; segment-flooring surfaced Homeland OI -46% / Entrust drag the original DD missed; FV cross-check ~fair-to-slightly-cheap not the original 3:1.
court_record.red_team_fable: NO ADD NOW (pre-print negative-EV) + AMENDED GATE. Conceded on primary data: goodwill mis-assignment ($1,791M->$2,729M Homeland), 'beating-and-raising' misleading (Entrust-mechanical +0.4% organic; week closed -12.5%), the June catalyst was DHA not VA (two simultaneous dismantlings), the pre-print toe is negative-EV, 'below street-low' is a decaying anchor. Added: the USASpending pre-funding tell + the Sep-30 obligation kill-bar + Health backlog-rate amendments to the gate.
court_record.adjudication: ACCEPTED IN FULL. All five concessions folded into the conviction + this record; pre-print toe WITHDRAWN; gate AMENDED; hard USASpending kill-bar adopted. Verdict: no add now; ~0.5% behind the amended Aug-4 gate; chase-cap $118.

Earliest long-term dates: BAH and J on 2027-05-27; the July cohort (BKE/IBEX/EQT/HCA/LDOS/OLLI) on 2027-07-07..14; III 2027-07-17; CI 2027-07-23; PRCT 2027-07-25. Every upside trim resting today therefore prices in SHORT-TERM dollars at ~50%, roughly double the long-term drag. This is a level input, not a reason to skip the band: a trim that only clears on strength is still wrong-side-safe, but the rungs below were set at court BULL/ceiling values (not base values) partly for this reason.
_common.wrong_side_test: Every rung below is a SELL limit ABOVE the market; it can only fill on strength, so it cannot fill on the thesis-killer. Downside kills are ALERT-class only -- no resting stops anywhere in this slice (a stop is the sell-side fills-on-the-cut trap).
